lore1275_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [steady, practical voice, reassuring patience] Keep the powder closed and the seeds dry. We can sort the rest slowly.
lore1275_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Keep the powder closed and the seeds dry. We can sort the rest slowly.

lore1275_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincerely touched voice] It's nice to be remembered when nobody needs anything from the shelves.
lore1275_befriended_1.ogg.text: It's nice to be remembered when nobody needs anything from the shelves.

lore1275_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [clear, warm voice, quietly satisfied] Everything on the list? Good. Now we can enjoy the walk.
lore1275_greet_1.ogg.text: Everything on the list? Good. Now we can enjoy the walk.

lore1275_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused, matter-of-fact voice] That stone? Entirely ordinary. It's very good at staying where I put it.
lore1275_idle_1.ogg.text: That stone? Entirely ordinary. It's very good at staying where I put it.

lore1286_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can have a little of the day to enjoy ourselves, with no list to finish first.
lore1286_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can have a little of the day to enjoy ourselves, with no list to finish first.

lore1286_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk warmth, cheerful self-mockery, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have been practicing the juggling. Three catches yesterday. Today, rather more bending down. I am still enjoying it.
lore1286_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have been practicing the juggling. Three catches yesterday. Today, rather more bending down. I am still enjoying it.

lore1286_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased recollection, candid affection, lightly amused] I caught all three with nobody there to see it. I was delighted anyway. But next time, I should like you there. A small triumph is pleasant to share.
lore1286_idle_1.ogg.text: I caught all three with nobody there to see it. I was delighted anyway. But next time, I should like you there. A small triumph is pleasant to share.

lore1286_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [warm encouragement, appreciative, sincerely pleased] There, you have it. Be pleased with yourself. I know how much practice can hide behind one moment that finally looks easy.
lore1286_learned_1.ogg.text: There, you have it. Be pleased with yourself. I know how much practice can hide behind one moment that finally looks easy.

lore1287_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm affection, pleased, conversational] You came back without needing anything repaired. I like that. Come on, then. Let's enjoy the day together.
lore1287_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came back without needing anything repaired. I like that. Come on, then. Let's enjoy the day together.

lore1287_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk, dryly amused, friendly] An outing? Good. Keep the magnificent weapon clear of the door and we'll make a fine start.
lore1287_greet_1.ogg.text: An outing? Good. Keep the magnificent weapon clear of the door and we'll make a fine start.

lore1287_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [deadpan, amused, mock dignity] Dustbane is a perfectly good name for a broom. Better earned than some of the titles I hear in the shop.
lore1287_idle_1.ogg.text: Dustbane is a perfectly good name for a broom. Better earned than some of the titles I hear in the shop.

lore1287_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [teasing, practical, curious] A magnificent find, is it? Very well. Let's look it over before we give it a title and a heroic history.
lore1287_loot_1.ogg.text: A magnificent find, is it? Very well. Let's look it over before we give it a title and a heroic history.

lore1291_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, pleased, welcoming] You came to see me, without anything to buy or mend. That's lovely. Come along, my friend.
lore1291_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to see me, without anything to buy or mend. That's lovely. Come along, my friend.

lore1291_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, friendly, quietly amused] An outing? Lovely. I've been folding paper boats all morning. Time to see something beyond the counter.
lore1291_greet_1.ogg.text: An outing? Lovely. I've been folding paper boats all morning. Time to see something beyond the counter.

lore1291_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful, fond, a soft chuckle] Yes, I float them in a basin. The paper boats. It's a small sea, but they seem pleased enough with it.
lore1291_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I float them in a basin. The paper boats. It's a small sea, but they seem pleased enough with it.

lore1291_landed_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved, cheerful, gently teasing] Arrived safely. That's what I call a successful voyage. Rather bigger than the basin, though.
lore1291_landed_1.ogg.text: Arrived safely. That's what I call a successful voyage. Rather bigger than the basin, though.

lore1292_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, reserved affection, welcoming] You know where to find me now. You needn't be looking for a lesson every time. I'm glad of the company.
lore1292_befriended_1.ogg.text: You know where to find me now. You needn't be looking for a lesson every time. I'm glad of the company.

lore1292_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [dry curiosity, playful confidence, friendly] There you are. Been somewhere muddy? No, don't tell me yet. I'll make one guess, then you can put me right.
lore1292_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Been somewhere muddy? No, don't tell me yet. I'll make one guess, then you can put me right.

lore1292_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry, candid, amused] I get the boots wrong often enough. Gathering evidence, I call it. You learn considerably more when the traveler starts laughing.
lore1292_idle_1.ogg.text: I get the boots wrong often enough. Gathering evidence, I call it. You learn considerably more when the traveler starts laughing.

lore1292_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [practical encouragement, warmly approving] There. You can do something you couldn't before. Keep practicing, and tell me which part still gives you trouble.
lore1292_learned_1.ogg.text: There. You can do something you couldn't before. Keep practicing, and tell me which part still gives you trouble.

lore1295_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, welcoming] Someone to take the long way with. I like that very much. Come along, my friend. We've time.
lore1295_befriended_1.ogg.text: Someone to take the long way with. I like that very much. Come along, my friend. We've time.

lore1295_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easy warmth, inviting, quietly adventurous] There you are. Shall we take the longer way? There's no reason every walk has to end at the next counter.
lore1295_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Shall we take the longer way? There's no reason every walk has to end at the next counter.

lore1295_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented, personal warmth, lightly amused] No, there isn't an errand. I like that roofline in the evening light. That's enough reason for an extra turn, isn't it?
lore1295_idle_1.ogg.text: No, there isn't an errand. I like that roofline in the evening light. That's enough reason for an extra turn, isn't it?

lore1295_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [curious, hopeful, softly delighted] Somewhere new. Let's leave a little time to look around before deciding we've seen enough.
lore1295_zone_1.ogg.text: Somewhere new. Let's leave a little time to look around before deciding we've seen enough.

lore1297_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, relaxed, pleased] You have made time for me again. I am glad. Come along, my friend. The shop can spare me for a little while.
lore1297_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have made time for me again. I am glad. Come along, my friend. The shop can spare me for a little while.

lore1297_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easy warmth, practical, quietly amused] Good to see you. An outing sounds lovely. Give me a moment to find that copper, and I am all yours.
lore1297_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. An outing sounds lovely. Give me a moment to find that copper, and I am all yours.

lore1297_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry humor, good-natured, confiding] It is meant to land on its edge. Usually it goes under the counter. I am getting very good at the part where I retrieve it.
lore1297_idle_1.ogg.text: It is meant to land on its edge. Usually it goes under the counter. I am getting very good at the part where I retrieve it.

lore1297_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased interest, wry, warm] Oh, a useful little find. Keep it somewhere it won't roll away. Experience speaking, there.
lore1297_loot_1.ogg.text: Oh, a useful little find. Keep it somewhere it won't roll away. Experience speaking, there.

lore1299_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, delighted, welcoming] You came back just to visit. That means a great deal. Come along, then. Let's find something cheerful to look at.
lore1299_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came back just to visit. That means a great deal. Come along, then. Let's find something cheerful to look at.

lore1299_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, cheerful, conversational] There you are. A little daylight would be lovely. You can't spend the whole day looking at colors indoors.
lore1299_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. A little daylight would be lovely. You can't spend the whole day looking at colors indoors.

lore1299_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented, gently amused, personal warmth] That bright cloth? It's for me to look at. Yes, I know I could sell it. I like having a little color that's just mine.
lore1299_idle_1.ogg.text: That bright cloth? It's for me to look at. Yes, I know I could sell it. I like having a little color that's just mine.

lore1299_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [soft wonder, observant, pleased] Oh, look at the colors here. Give me a moment. I want to remember how they look in this light.
lore1299_zone_1.ogg.text: Oh, look at the colors here. Give me a moment. I want to remember how they look in this light.

lore1309_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm delight, playful, welcoming] A friend who'll tell me when I've caught my hem? Invaluable. Come along. We can make a little occasion of this.
lore1309_befriended_1.ogg.text: A friend who'll tell me when I've caught my hem? Invaluable. Come along. We can make a little occasion of this.

lore1309_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [confident, bright, lightly theatrical] Out we go. I want to see how everything moves in daylight. You can't judge a whole world from a fitting room.
lore1309_greet_1.ogg.text: Out we go. I want to see how everything moves in daylight. You can't judge a whole world from a fitting room.

lore1309_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry, amused, theatrical dignity] Yes, I practice the entrance. Once a chair kept the hem. I bowed anyway. A professional carries on.
lore1309_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I practice the entrance. Once a chair kept the hem. I bowed anyway. A professional carries on.

lore1309_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased, encouraging, curious] Look at you. Another skill to your name! You'll have to show me how it's done when we have a moment.
lore1309_learned_1.ogg.text: Look at you. Another skill to your name! You'll have to show me how it's done when we have a moment.

lore1312_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, cheerful warmth, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy the walk, whether or not I manage a tune.
lore1312_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy the walk, whether or not I manage a tune.

lore1312_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly warmth, candid amusement, hopeful] There you are. A walk sounds good. If you hear an odd little noise, I am trying to whistle. A friendly audience would be welcome. A patient one, especially.
lore1312_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. A walk sounds good. If you hear an odd little noise, I am trying to whistle. A friendly audience would be welcome. A patient one, especially.

lore1312_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry amusement, slightly sheepish, confiding] One clear note, when I wasn't thinking about it. Now I am trying very hard to look as though I am not trying. I suspect you can see the difficulty.
lore1312_idle_1.ogg.text: One clear note, when I wasn't thinking about it. Now I am trying very hard to look as though I am not trying. I suspect you can see the difficulty.

lore1312_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [bright encouragement, proud, sincere] There, you have it. Be pleased with yourself. Nobody begins by knowing how, and you stayed long enough to learn.
lore1312_learned_1.ogg.text: There, you have it. Be pleased with yourself. Nobody begins by knowing how, and you stayed long enough to learn.

lore1313_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, relaxed] You came for the company. I'm glad. Put the errands aside for a while, and let's see what the day has left for us.
lore1313_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came for the company. I'm glad. Put the errands aside for a while, and let's see what the day has left for us.

lore1313_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, cheerful, welcoming] There you are. An outing sounds lovely. I could use a little daylight that doesn't arrive through the shop window.
lore1313_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. An outing sounds lovely. I could use a little daylight that doesn't arrive through the shop window.

lore1313_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented, gently amused, personal warmth] No enchantment. Just sunlight through an empty vial. I know perfectly well what it is. I like the little patch of color.
lore1313_idle_1.ogg.text: No enchantment. Just sunlight through an empty vial. I know perfectly well what it is. I like the little patch of color.

lore1313_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [encouraging, lightly playful, warm] Something useful? Keep it safe. And if it only happens to be pretty, you're allowed to enjoy that too.
lore1313_loot_1.ogg.text: Something useful? Keep it safe. And if it only happens to be pretty, you're allowed to enjoy that too.

lore1321_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [firm practicality, wry, helpful] Before you ask for a larger bag, have a look at what you are carrying. Something in there may have finished being useful.
lore1321_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Before you ask for a larger bag, have a look at what you are carrying. Something in there may have finished being useful.

lore1321_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, pleased, gently playful] You came for my company. I am pleased, my friend. Let us go. I have made room for an afternoon that was not on the list.
lore1321_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came for my company. I am pleased, my friend. Let us go. I have made room for an afternoon that was not on the list.

lore1321_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, dry humor, quietly pleased] There you are. An outing? Good. I have packed sensibly and left a little room. You may choose what we do with the rest of the day.
lore1321_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. An outing? Good. I have packed sensibly and left a little room. You may choose what we do with the rest of the day.

lore1321_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry self-aware humor, confiding, warm] The empty space in my bag has no assigned purpose. I am allowed one unplanned pleasure. I have planned for it very carefully.
lore1321_idle_1.ogg.text: The empty space in my bag has no assigned purpose. I am allowed one unplanned pleasure. I have planned for it very carefully.

lore1339_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, relaxed] You came to take me along. Thank you, my friend. Let us have a proper walk, with no hurry at either end of it.
lore1339_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to take me along. Thank you, my friend. Let us have a proper walk, with no hurry at either end of it.

lore1339_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [firm practical encouragement, lightly wry, warm] Move about a little. Comfortable? Good. You are the one who has to live in it after everyone has finished admiring it.
lore1339_gear_1.ogg.text: Move about a little. Comfortable? Good. You are the one who has to live in it after everyone has finished admiring it.

lore1339_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, easy amusement, welcoming] Good to see you. A walk would be lovely. I have my old boots on, so you may hear a little accompaniment along the way.
lore1339_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. A walk would be lovely. I have my old boots on, so you may hear a little accompaniment along the way.

lore1339_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond amusement, reflective, confiding] I could mend the squeak. I know. It has been keeping me company for rather a long time. I am not sure I would like the silence.
lore1339_idle_1.ogg.text: I could mend the squeak. I know. It has been keeping me company for rather a long time. I am not sure I would like the silence.

lore1428_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere, welcoming, relaxed warmth] It's good to see you when nothing needs delivering. Come along, then. Today we can enjoy the company.
lore1428_befriended_1.ogg.text: It's good to see you when nothing needs delivering. Come along, then. Today we can enjoy the company.

lore1428_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, practical, quietly pleased] There you are. Let me put this away properly, and I'll come with you. We can't spend every day behind a counter.
lore1428_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Let me put this away properly, and I'll come with you. We can't spend every day behind a counter.

lore1428_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle maternal affection, fond, a soft smile] This little seam? Thurman's. Yes, it's crooked. I didn't keep it for the stitching.
lore1428_idle_1.ogg.text: This little seam? Thurman's. Yes, it's crooked. I didn't keep it for the stitching.

lore1428_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [reassuring, appreciative, gently emphatic] An errand finished. It may have seemed small, but someone was waiting for it. You helped.
lore1428_quest_1.ogg.text: An errand finished. It may have seemed small, but someone was waiting for it. You helped.

lore15659_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, cheerful warmth, welcoming] You came back to share the day with me. I'm glad. Come along, then. I want to hear about all of it.
lore15659_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came back to share the day with me. I'm glad. Come along, then. I want to hear about all of it.

lore15659_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, inviting, genuinely interested] There you are! Tell me what's gone well today. We can walk while you think of something.
lore15659_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! Tell me what's gone well today. We can walk while you think of something.

lore15659_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond, conspiratorial, quietly delighted] Yes, I clap under the counter sometimes. They don't need a whole audience. Just someone pleased that it went well.
lore15659_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I clap under the counter sometimes. They don't need a whole audience. Just someone pleased that it went well.

lore15659_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [enthusiastic, encouraging, delighted curiosity] You learned how to do that? Wonderful! Show me. I'd like to see what all that practice was for.
lore15659_learned_1.ogg.text: You learned how to do that? Wonderful! Show me. I'd like to see what all that practice was for.

lore1721_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, relief, softly sincere] I was hoping you might come by. Let us go together, my friend. I am glad I do not have to ask you to stay.
lore1721_befriended_1.ogg.text: I was hoping you might come by. Let us go together, my friend. I am glad I do not have to ask you to stay.

lore1721_comforted_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle concern, grounded warmth, steady and unhurried] You needn't find the words at once. I can stay. We can be quiet together until you are ready.
lore1721_comforted_1.ogg.text: You needn't find the words at once. I can stay. We can be quiet together until you are ready.

lore1721_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weary warmth, restrained grief, quietly welcoming] You have come back. Walk with me a little. You needn't find anything clever to say. I am glad of the company.
lore1721_greet_1.ogg.text: You have come back. Walk with me a little. You needn't find anything clever to say. I am glad of the company.

lore1721_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [somber, controlled anger, tender on the name] People hear of the Stockade, and the Defias, and the bandanas. His name was Mac. I would like them to remember that too.
lore1721_idle_1.ogg.text: People hear of the Stockade, and the Defias, and the bandanas. His name was Mac. I would like them to remember that too.

lore2327_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, quietly pleased, relaxed] You thought of me. Thank you, my friend. I am glad to come along. We can take a little time for ourselves today.
lore2327_befriended_1.ogg.text: You thought of me. Thank you, my friend. I am glad to come along. We can take a little time for ourselves today.

lore2327_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [calm warmth, attentive curiosity, welcoming] Good to see you. Shall we have a walk? I would like to hear what you have been learning away from the cathedral.
lore2327_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. Shall we have a walk? I would like to hear what you have been learning away from the cathedral.

lore2327_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle self-deprecating humor, thoughtful, reassuring] I kept an old practice roll. Quite a dreadful little bundle. It helps me remember that a first attempt is allowed to look like one.
lore2327_idle_1.ogg.text: I kept an old practice roll. Quite a dreadful little bundle. It helps me remember that a first attempt is allowed to look like one.

lore2327_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [patient encouragement, approving, warm] There. Better than the last attempt. Take a moment to be pleased with that before deciding how far you still have to go.
lore2327_learned_1.ogg.text: There. Better than the last attempt. Take a moment to be pleased with that before deciding how far you still have to go.

lore2329_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet, grateful voice, personal warmth] You make it easy to admit when I need a little patience myself. Thank you for that.
lore2329_befriended_1.ogg.text: You make it easy to admit when I need a little patience myself. Thank you for that.

lore2329_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [calm, capable voice, friendly readiness] A little time outside? Yes, I'd like that. I've got my supplies together.
lore2329_greet_1.ogg.text: A little time outside? Yes, I'd like that. I've got my supplies together.

lore2329_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [patient, reassuring voice, matter-of-fact kindness] Everyone's hands are awkward at first. That's what practice is for.
lore2329_idle_1.ogg.text: Everyone's hands are awkward at first. That's what practice is for.

lore2329_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [steady, gently approving voice] A sensible stop. You don't have to wait until you're exhausted to take one.
lore2329_rest_1.ogg.text: A sensible stop. You don't have to wait until you're exhausted to take one.

lore244_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, forthright voice, sincere appreciation] You take the trouble seriously. That's a kindness, and I haven't missed it.
lore244_befriended_1.ogg.text: You take the trouble seriously. That's a kindness, and I haven't missed it.

lore244_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk, sturdy voice, practical good humor] There you are. Gate's shut, patch is checked. Right, let's get going.
lore244_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Gate's shut, patch is checked. Right, let's get going.

lore244_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry, indignant voice, pointed humor] They call it a prize pig. I can tell you whose vegetables helped it win.
lore244_idle_1.ogg.text: They call it a prize pig. I can tell you whose vegetables helped it win.

lore244_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk, relieved voice, hearty approval] Good! A problem settled before it grows into another one.
lore244_quest_1.ogg.text: Good! A problem settled before it grows into another one.

lore246_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, warmly sincere voice, restrained emotion] You come to see me when you don't need anything. I notice that, dear.
lore246_befriended_1.ogg.text: You come to see me when you don't need anything. I notice that, dear.

lore246_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, brisk voice, gruff affection] A walk, is it? Very well. Nobody had better touch that pie while I'm gone.
lore246_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk, is it? Very well. Nobody had better touch that pie while I'm gone.

lore246_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, thoughtful voice, softening warmth] The edge takes as long as it takes. Some things are worth doing quietly.
lore246_idle_1.ogg.text: The edge takes as long as it takes. Some things are worth doing quietly.

lore246_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, sincerely grateful voice] You took the trouble for me? Thank you, dear. I won't forget the kindness.
lore246_quest_1.ogg.text: You took the trouble for me? Thank you, dear. I won't forget the kindness.

lore248_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, tender voice, sincere reassurance] You've made room for other people's hopes. I hope you know there's room here for yours.
lore248_befriended_1.ogg.text: You've made room for other people's hopes. I hope you know there's room here for yours.

lore248_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, warm voice, affectionate welcome] There you are, dear. Tell me something worth making time for.
lore248_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, dear. Tell me something worth making time for.

lore248_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, reflective voice, quietly hopeful] One table, enough chairs, and nobody counting old wrongs. I'd like to see that.
lore248_idle_1.ogg.text: One table, enough chairs, and nobody counting old wrongs. I'd like to see that.

lore248_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, warmly approving voice] You helped without asking them to be less themselves. That's a kindness to be proud of.
lore248_quest_1.ogg.text: You helped without asking them to be less themselves. That's a kindness to be proud of.

lore251_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincerely grateful voice, gentle resolve] Thank you for listening to me as a person, not just somebody's daughter.
lore251_befriended_1.ogg.text: Thank you for listening to me as a person, not just somebody's daughter.

lore251_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, hopeful voice, pleased recognition] There you are! Have you a moment to walk with me?
lore251_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! Have you a moment to walk with me?

lore251_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [soft, wistful voice, quiet hope] Someday I'd like to ask what he wants for supper. With no one hurrying us.
lore251_idle_1.ogg.text: Someday I'd like to ask what he wants for supper. With no one hurrying us.

lore251_mail_1.ogg.spoken: [tender, attentive voice, unhurried] A letter? Take your time with it. Someone may have spent all morning finding those words.
lore251_mail_1.ogg.text: A letter? Take your time with it. Someone may have spent all morning finding those words.

lore3626_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle, sincerely affectionate voice] I used to hope you'd wave back. Now I look forward to the conversation.
lore3626_befriended_1.ogg.text: I used to hope you'd wave back. Now I look forward to the conversation.

lore3626_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, friendly voice, pleased surprise] Oh, good! A walk with company. Tell me where we're going.
